sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Trophies is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Mercenary, come here for a minute. I have an order of elimination of several groups of PMCs, the highly experienced ones. Sending my soldiers to this would be a suicide mission, so that is why I suggest you to handle this matter. What do you say? As proof of the work done, you have to bring me dogtags from both of those groups."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find and hand over 10 BEAR PMC dogtags of level 20+ to Peacekeeper
- Find and hand over 10 USEC PMC dogtags of level 20+ to Peacekeeper
- Eliminate 12 PMC operatives

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- +4 Pistols skill levels
- +4 Revolvers skill levels
- Peacekeeper Rep +1.5
- 2,750 Dollars
  - 2,887 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 3,162 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Crye Precision AirFrame helmet (Tan)
- Unlocks purchase of Crye Precision AirFrame helmet (Tan) at Peacekeeper LL4
"Great, great! The clients have already rewa– uh, thanked us for the successful mission. Good job, mercenary."
